t-vs-normal.alt: Three bell-shaped density curves centered at 0 on an axis from -4.5 to 4.5: the standard normal (solid black), the t distribution with 15 degrees of freedom (dashed blue) and the t distribution with 3 degrees of freedom (orange), which is lowest in the middle and highest in the tails. Dashed marks show the 95% critical values: z* = 1.96, t* = 2.131 for 15 df and t* = 3.182 for 3 df. The outer 5% of the 3 df curve is shaded.
